item.title: It's when you stop having passion and love for your offering and the…
item.description: It's when you stop having passion and love for your offering and the people who use it, that you stop getting new ideas for it and stop innovating. And then, the competition eats your market share away.
item.content:encoded: It's when you stop having passion and love for your offering and the people who use it, that you stop getting new ideas for it and stop innovating. And then, the competition eats your market share away.

item.title: You have an idea for a new feature for your offering, and then the…
item.description: You have an idea for a new feature for your offering, and then the process of building that new feature is what will bring out newer, better ideas for the next iteration for your offering. That is how you always stay ahead of your competition who might just be busy copying you. They will always be late.

item.title: I just keep shifting the dates on the article release because writing…
item.description: I just keep shifting the dates on the article release because writing for writing's sake is a very long process. You find something to re-write 'in a better way' in the text each time you look at it. And at some point you just release it, once you make yourself acquiesce to the fact that it never ends.
